about: Each person's points on each alignment question from the bills, amendments and roll calls coded to it (data/question-bills.json), one credit per bill: {bioguide: {question: [points for sides[0], points for sides[1], and, for the reviewed profiles, the first and latest vote toward sides[0] and toward sides[1]]}}. coded: how many bills, amendments and roll calls are coded to each question. Written by scripts/build-question-record.mjs; the stances, leans and matches are worked out in public/question-scores.js.
